response.title: which solar generator has the longest lasting battery in years
response.answer:
If you're looking for a solar generator whose battery lasts the most years before needing replacement, I recommend focusing on models using LiFePO4 (lithium iron phosphate) batteries.

The longest-lasting consumer solar generators typically offer:

10–15+ years of potential battery life under favorable conditions.

4,000–6,000+ charge cycles before battery capacity drops to a specified level, often 70–80%.

5–10 years of warranty coverage, depending on the manufacturer.

One important distinction: a battery rated for 6,000 cycles isn't automatically guaranteed to last 15 years. Calendar aging, temperature, charging habits, and usage all matter.
